时笙一早就防着江源一家，所以在他们找媒体的时候，她第一时间知道了，她让胡硕去见了他们。

胡硕二话不说就答应了。

因为夏萱的事，胡硕的工作室现在可是很有名气，他的身价也水涨船高，一般人他是不会接的，但是对于时笙这个给了他一飞冲天机会的女子，他很愿意帮忙的。

胡硕买通了不少的狗仔，然后带着一群人浩浩荡荡的去找江源。

江源见这么多的媒体，觉得一定可以让江晚服软，她在怎么厉害也不过是个女人，在传统的国家，不忠不孝不仁不义是大忌，以后会被人戳脊梁骨。

江源的想法也是够单蠢的，他也不想想娱乐圈这个地方，怎么可能像他家小区那么简单。

江真真心底隐隐不安，觉得这么做有些不对，可惜拗不过江源。

他们等着明天的新闻，等着明天时笙给他们赔礼道歉。

可是没有。

第二天什么都没发生。

唔，也不是什么都没发现，时笙又更新了婚纱照，最后一张图依旧是RMB。

接下来几天依旧风平浪静，时笙定时定点的喂狗粮，最后一张都是RMB叠成的各种图案。

对于时笙这种炫‘夫’行为，粉丝们已经很淡定了，当然也有人骂的，不过太不起眼，很快就被舔屏的人给刷下去了。

就在江源快要等不下去的时候，网上总算有了消息，但是和他想的却完全不一样。

那上面说的，是一家子如何占了弟弟的家产，苛待侄女，最后在侄女凭着自己能力有了公司后，还想来分一杯羹。

胡硕的文笔没得说，加上他工作室的名声，网友自然就相信了，而且很快就有人扒出来江源一家的信息。

和文里隐晦提及的几点，立即就对上了号。

在江源生活的那个城市自然有人喜欢时笙，江源身边的人也不在少数，他们只知道江家出了一个明星，却不想这里面还有这么一段故事。

一些比较熟悉的，就知道当年江晚过得并不是很好。

穿的用的都是江真真用剩下的，一年到头也没见她换过新衣裳。

几乎不用特意去挖掘，江源一家的一些恶习就被人爆了出来。

江源想用网络的力量来对付她，那她就怎么还给他们。

网上的粉丝开始声讨江源一家，他们住的酒店被胡硕用小号发了出去，一时间江源一家几乎是被堵在酒店。

“人家小丸子哪里亏待你们，这卡莱尔酒店总统套房一晚上，一晚上一万多，你们哪里来的脸说小丸子忘恩负义？”

“真是林子大了什么鸟都有，人家小丸子和你不过是亲戚，还隔着一房呢，凭什么觊觎人家小丸子的家产！你们要不要脸，当我们家小丸子没人是不是！”

Shi Sheng had been on guard against Jiang Yuan's family since early in the morning, so when they approached the media, she knew about it immediately and asked Hu Shuo to meet them.

Hu Shuo agreed without saying a word.

Because of Xia Xuan's incident, Hu Shuo's studio is now very famous, and his worth has also risen. Most people would not accept it, but for Shi Sheng, a woman who gave him a chance to skyrocket, he is very willing to help.

Hu Shuo bribed a lot of paparazzi, and then led a group of people to find Jiang Yuan.

Jiang Yuan saw so many media outlets and felt that Jiang Wan could be subdued. No matter how powerful she was, she was just a woman. In a traditional country, being unfaithful, unfilial, and unkind was a taboo, and someone would poke her in the back in the future.

Jiang Yuan's idea was simple and stupid. He didn't even think about how the entertainment industry could be as simple as his neighborhood.

Jiang Zhenzhen felt uneasy in his heart and felt that something was wrong with this, but unfortunately he couldn't resist Jiang Yuan.

They were waiting for tomorrow's news, waiting for Shi Sheng to apologize to them tomorrow.

But no.

The next day nothing happened.

Well, it's not like I didn't find anything. Shi Sheng updated the wedding photos again, and the last picture is still RMB.

The next few days were still calm, Shi Sheng fed the dog food at regular intervals, and the last one was filled with various patterns made of RMB.

Fans have been very calm about Shi Sheng's behavior of showing off her husband. Of course, some people scolded her, but it was too inconspicuous and was quickly dismissed by screen lickers.

Just when Jiang Yuan could hardly wait any longer, news finally came online, but it was completely different from what he thought.

What it talks about is how the family took over the younger brother's property, treated the niece harshly, and finally wanted to get a share of the pie after the niece established a company based on her own abilities.

Hu Shuo's writing style was nothing short of great, and coupled with the reputation of his studio, netizens naturally believed him, and soon someone found out information about Jiang Yuan's family.

The points mentioned implicitly in the article immediately clicked.

Naturally, there were people in the city where Jiang Yuan lived who liked Shi Sheng, and there were also many people around Jiang Yuan. They only knew that the Jiang family had a star, but they didn't expect that there was such a story in it.

Those who are familiar with her know that Jiang Wan's life was not very good back then.

The clothes she wore were all Jiang Zhenzhen's leftovers, and she never changed into new clothes throughout the year.

Almost without any special digging, some of Jiang Yuan's family's bad habits were revealed.

Jiang Yuan wants to use the power of the Internet to deal with her, so how can she return it to them?

Fans on the Internet began to denounce the Jiang Yuan family. The hotel they were staying in was posted by Hu Shuo on a trumpet account. For a while, the Jiang Yuan family was almost blocked in the hotel.

"How could Xiaowanzi treat you so badly? The presidential suite at the Carlyle Hotel costs more than 10,000 yuan per night. How can you have the nerve to say that Xiaowanzi is ungrateful?"

"The forest is really big and there are all kinds of birds. My little ball and you are just relatives, and we are separated by a room. Why are you coveting my little ball's property! You are so shameless, don't you think our little ball has no one!"
